The source value is an 8‑character string in `YYYYMMDD` format; we convert it to a proper `DATE` by inserting dashes, and return `NULL` when the string is empty or missing.

```sql
CASE
  WHEN CMP.FoundingDate IS NULL OR CMP.FoundingDate = '' THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(
         SUBSTR(CMP.FoundingDate,1,4) || '-' ||
         SUBSTR(CMP.FoundingDate,5,2) || '-' ||
         SUBSTR(CMP.FoundingDate,7,2)
       AS DATE)
END
```

The expression flags a prospect as a customer when a DimCustomer record exists with matching name, address, and postal code values, using case-insensitive comparison and NULL-safe equality to handle data quality variations.

```sql
EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM DimCustomer C
    WHERE UPPER(C.FirstName) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM UPPER(P.FirstName)
      AND UPPER(C.LastName) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM UPPER(P.LastName)
      AND UPPER(C.AddressLine1) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM UPPER(P.AddressLine1)
      AND UPPER(C.AddressLine2) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM UPPER(P.AddressLine2)
      AND UPPER(C.PostalCode) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM UPPER(P.PostalCode)
)
```

Concatenate the available Prospect demographic and financial attributes into a labeled string, trim excess spaces, truncate to 100 characters, and return NULL when no Prospect row is matched.

```sql
NULLIF(
  LEFT(
    TRIM(
      COALESCE('Age ' || CAST(P.Age AS VARCHAR) || ' ', '') ||
      COALESCE('NetWorth ' || CAST(P.NetWorth AS VARCHAR) || ' ', '') ||
      COALESCE('Income ' || CAST(P.Income AS VARCHAR) || ' ', '') ||
      COALESCE('Children ' || CAST(P.NumberChildren AS VARCHAR) || ' ', '') ||
      COALESCE('CreditCards ' || CAST(P.NumberCreditCards AS VARCHAR) || ' ', '') ||
      COALESCE('Cars ' || CAST(P.NumberCars AS VARCHAR) || ' ', '') ||
      COALESCE('CreditRating ' || CAST(P.CreditRating AS VARCHAR), '')
    ), 100
  ), ''
)
```
